Passes -XX:ActiveProcessorCount to the JVM so it sees the right core count on phones that misreport their own. Always clamped to 1-16, falling back to 8 if the device reports something bogus.

Pins the JVM\'s worker threads toward this device\'s big/performance cores instead of leaving core placement to the OS scheduler.
Hints the native side to favor steadier frame delivery over raw throughput under CPU contention.
Keeps the allocated RAM pinned to the best pick for this device instead of a value you set by hand on the Game Settings slider.
-Xms = -Xmx: reserves the full heap up front for fewer heap-resize GC pauses. Off starts the heap at half of -Xmx and lets the JVM grow it as needed.

Periodically checks the system\'s memory pressure and warns before the OS is likely to kill the game process outright.
Logs every GC pause to gc.log in the launcher cache directory, for diagnosing a slow session after the fact.
GL4ES-family renderers only (Holy GL4ES). No effect on LTW, MobileGlues, Zink, VirGL, VGPU, or Freedreno.
Removes Minecraft\'s 300-FPS cap and disables explicit GC pauses. May increase heat and battery drain.
Enables JVM string and compilation optimizations that reduce per-frame allocation overhead for smoother rendering.
Activates LWJGL frame pacing hints for more evenly spaced frame delivery on mobile GPUs.
Allows the renderer to drop frames when overloaded instead of queuing them. Reduces input lag on low-end devices.
Uses G1GC with short max-pause targets (10ms) to prevent garbage collection from stalling mid-frame.
Periodically runs a G1 garbage collection during idle stretches to release memory back to the system, instead of holding onto peak usage all session.
Automatically tunes renderer, driver, RAM allocation, resolution scale, and FPS Boost flags for your device at launch. Recommended for most users.
Quick switch between OpenGL and Vulkan rendering. This is a shortcut for the detailed Renderer option below — OpenGL picks GL4ES, Vulkan picks Zink.
On uses the OpenGL (GL4ES) renderer. Off switches to Vulkan (Zink). Same shortcut as the detailed Renderer option below — default is On (OpenGL).

%s is a Minecraft launcher by Endiq that allows Minecraft: Java Edition to run on Android devices.

%s focuses on optimizing user experience, redesigning the application interface, and adding more practical features, aiming to lower the barriers to play and let more people enjoy the fun of Minecraft easily.

%s uses the GPL 3.0 open-source license, which is "viral." Any code that uses, modifies, or derives from GPL libraries or software must also adopt the GPL license for open sourcing. If you intend to distribute this software, please comply with the relevant provisions of the GPL 3.0 open-source license.

The game\'s own output — mod loaders, console messages, crash traces — is captured into the launcher log. The home screen\'s Last Game Log card shows the last session across restarts, and the Assistant can read it when you ask why the game crashed.
